summary: Green Circle Decarbonize Technology Limited, a Cayman Islands company listed on NYSE, filed a Form 6-K on September 8, 2026, announcing a strategic partnership agreement with SANVO Fine Chemicals Group Limited. Under the agreement, SANVO becomes sole supplier and exclusive manufacturer of the company's BocaPCM-TES Panels in China, leveraging existing production facilities to reduce capital expenditures and accelerate time-to-market. The initial term is three years with automatic extensions. This is a routine operational supply/manufacturing contract, not a special-situation corporate event. No deal terms, financial details, or board recommendations are disclosed. The arrangement is a commercial partnership, not an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring.
